question: Should bundled dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets be accepted now, and what redaction, permission, retention, export, and command-binding boundaries must they follow?
rationale: The feature is plausible and aligned with operator ergonomics, but it exposes logs and command output in a new always-visible dashboard surface and depends on unresolved dashboard binding/security decisions.

options.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
options.body: Keep this issue open, land or reject the dashboard substrate first, then implement widgets only against approved read and binding contracts.

options.title: Narrow To Existing Read-Only Contracts
options.body: Allow only a focused widget design over existing `logs.tail` and already-recorded output, excluding new command execution or generic command bindings.

options.title: Defer Bundled Builtins
options.body: Leave this as roadmap context until maintainers sponsor bundled dashboard widgets or a plugin API path makes external implementation sufficient.

recommendation.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, land or reject the dashboard substrate first, then implement widgets only against approved read and binding contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest current-main history across the Control UI plugin-tab and log-tail surfaces that the decision would affect.
